messages.author: 70efe4cff97fa154
messages.subject: Shiny server install errors
parts:
Hi, 

I just tried to install shiny server on two separate machnes running  ubuntu 12.10 and ubuntu 12.04 LTS respectively. A couple of errors popped up. First, if I understand correctly, it appears that the node - npm install instruction at: https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/wiki/Ubuntu-step-by-step-install-instructions could be changed from: "sudo apt-get install nodejs npm" to "sudo apt-get install nodejs" as npm is now installed automatically as part of nodejs. 

Second, both attempts at installing shiny server choked at the install node-unixgroups part of the script. It looks like the install script is looking for node 0.6 or 0.8 and the latest version that got installed in my case was 0.10.4. Sounds like I've run into the same problem as Yinchong Yang, but being an easily confused sort, I'm having trouble understanding the instructions that solved the problem in his case

("Assuming you are running Node 0.8.18 on your Ubuntu box, you should be able to find it at ~/.node-gyp/0.8.18. Copy that directory to the same location in the home directory on the Red Hat box. Once shiny-server is successfully installed you can delete it, I believe").

No hurry on this, as I'm just trying to understand the setup process and play with the server a bit, but still curious. The relevant parts of the install errors below:

npm http 200 https://github.com/rstudio/node-unixgroups/tarball/af6544c
npm WARN engine log...@0.5.8: wanted: {"node":"~0.6||~0.8"} (current: {"node":"v0.10.4","npm":"1.2.18"})

> unixg...@0.1.0 install /usr/lib/node_modules/shiny-server/node_modules/unixgroups
> node-gyp rebuild

npm http GET https://registry.npmjs.org/fresh/0.1.0
npm http GET https://registry.npmjs.org/range-parser/0.0.4
npm http GET https://registry.npmjs.org/debug
npm http GET https://registry.npmjs.org/mime/1.2.6
gyp WARN EACCES user "root" does not have permission to access the dev dir "/home/are/.node-gyp/0.10.4"
gyp WARN EACCES attempting to reinstall using temporary dev dir "/usr/lib/node_modules/shiny-server/node_modules/unixgroups/.node-gyp"
gy

Best regards -- Are
